name: SmileCare Dental
hours_message: SmileCare Dental is open Monday to Friday, 10am to 7pm, and Saturday 10am to 4pm. We're closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-in patients?
faqs.answer: SmileCare accepts walk-ins for dental emergencies until one hour before closing.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: SmileCare Dental is open Monday to Friday, 10am to 7pm, and Saturday 10am to 4pm. We're closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, SmileCare has free parking in the basement level of the building.

faqs.question: How do I book a cleaning?
faqs.answer: Call reception or use the online portal to book a cleaning; hygienist slots are usually available within a week.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Yes, SmileCare treats patients of all ages, including children's dentistry.
